description: This file defines the PyProcessGroup class and related classes for Python bindings in PyTorch's distributed package, including trampoline classes for ProcessGroup and Work, and a Python hook class.

classes.name: PyProcessGroup
classes.description: A trampoline class for Python to inherit from torch.distributed.ProcessGroup, enabling Python subclasses to override C++ methods.

classes.name: PyProcessGroup::PyWork
classes.description: A trampoline class for Python to inherit from torch.distributed.Work, allowing Python overrides of wait and getFuture.

classes.name: PyProcessGroup::PyWorkHolder
classes.description: A wrapper to hold a Python Work object and prevent it from being garbage collected.

classes.name: PythonOnCompletionHook
classes.description: A class wrapping a Python hook object to be called upon work completion, managing GIL and exception handling.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Overrides Work::wait, calls Python override if available.

methods.name: getFuture
methods.description: Overrides Work::getFuture, calls Python override if available.

methods.name: getBackendName
methods.description: Returns the backend name of the process group.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the process in the group.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the process group.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the process group operation.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the group name.

methods.name: getGroupDesc
methods.description: Returns the group description.

methods.name: setGroupDesc
methods.description: Sets the group description.

methods.name: splitGroup
methods.description: Splits the process group into subgroups based on ranks.

methods.name: mergeRemoteGroup
methods.description: Merges remote groups using a store and options.

methods.name: allgather
methods.description: Performs an allgather operation across processes.

methods.name: allgather_into_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced allgather into tensors.

methods.name: allreduce
methods.description: Performs an allreduce operation on tensors.

methods.name: allreduce_coalesced
methods.description: Performs a coalesced allreduce on tensors.

methods.name: alltoall_base
methods.description: Performs an alltoall operation with split sizes.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Synchronizes all processes.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts tensors to all processes.

methods.name: reduce_scatter
methods.description: Performs reduce-scatter operation.

methods.name: reduce_scatter_tensor_coalesced
methods.description: Coalesced reduce-scatter operation.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends tensors to a specified rank.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives tensors from a specified rank.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the Python hook with work info, managing exceptions.
